description: Java class 'SwipeRefreshMultipleViewsFragment' implementing a fragment that demonstrates the use of SwipeRefreshLayout combined with a GridView to provide swipe-to-refresh functionality in an Android app. It manages refresh actions, updates a list adapter with dummy data, and handles UI components for empty views and options menu interactions.

classes.name: SwipeRefreshMultipleViewsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment demonstrating swipe-to-refresh functionality with GridView, including menu actions to refresh and clear data, with simulated background data loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, enabling options menu.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes the SwipeRefreshLayout and GridView components.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the list adapter, empty view, swipeable children, and refresh listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks for refresh and clear actions.

methods.name: onRefreshComplete
methods.description: Updates adapter with new data and stops refresh animation.

methods.name: DummyBackgroundTask
methods.description: AsyncTask simulating data fetch with a delay, generating dummy cheese list.
